extracted.intended_audience: government communications teams and partner organisations
extracted.subtask_description: Defines and classifies types of partnership activity for government marketing and communications, to guide how government teams work with external partners and what to expect from each partnership type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Raising awareness
rubrics_metrics.description: Raising awareness: amplifying government messages through one or more of partners’ marketing and communications channels (online and offline).

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting: providing and signposting solutions that motivate, support and sustain behaviour change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsorship: a commercial agreement by which a sponsor contractually provides financing to establish an association between the sponsor’s organisation, brand or products and a sponsorship property (e.g. a government campaign) in return for the rights to promote this association.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business/policy partnership
rubrics_metrics.description: Business/policy partnership: government defines the policy framework, sets basic standards and facilitates partner involvement. Partners create and deliver initiatives/services that provide solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategic engagement: building alliances with third parties to listen effectively, share content and communicate policy messages with the aim of enhancing government understanding, support and reputation.
